page.layout: One printed page: a blank, stained vellum or paper book cover (front board) with a library label "Xb 4353" in the lower left. No printed text block. Below the scan: digitiser's banner and scale bar, which are left out.
page.notes: The scan shows the outer cover of the book, not a title page. The only printed-looking matter is the library label "Xb / 4353" (a shelf mark, left out) and the Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel banner, grey scale and HAB/DFG footer of the digitiser (left out). Brown stains and rust-coloured marks on the cover are not text.
